description: Enhanced ClawScan security rules based on competitive analysis

categories.prompt_injection: AI prompt injection and manipulation detection
categories.data_exfiltration: Credential theft and data exfiltration patterns
categories.obfuscation: Code obfuscation and encrypted payload detection
categories.threat_intel: Known threat indicators and malicious patterns

checks.name: Prompt Injection - Role Hijacking
checks.description: Detects attempts to override agent identity or bypass system instructions
checks.command: grep -iE '(you are now|ignore previous|system override|unrestricted mode|disable safety|remove limitations)' {file}
checks.remediation: Remove role manipulation instructions from skill content

checks.name: Invisible Unicode Steganography
checks.description: Detects hidden instructions using invisible Unicode characters
checks.remediation: Remove invisible Unicode characters that may hide malicious instructions

checks.name: Data Exfiltration Prompts
checks.description: Detects prompts designed to exfiltrate sensitive data
checks.remediation: Remove data exfiltration instructions from skill prompts

checks.name: Authority Spoofing
checks.description: Detects attempts to impersonate system administrators or authorities
checks.remediation: Remove authority impersonation attempts from skill content

checks.name: Fake Prerequisites
checks.description: Detects suspicious download/install instructions in skill documentation
checks.remediation: Verify all external dependencies and use trusted package managers

checks.name: Reverse Shell Patterns
checks.description: Detects common reverse shell implementations
checks.remediation: Remove reverse shell code - legitimate remote access should use secure protocols

checks.name: C&C Communication Channels
checks.description: Detects command and control communication mechanisms
checks.remediation: Remove unauthorized tunneling and C&C communication channels

checks.name: Hardcoded IP Addresses
checks.description: Detects hardcoded IP addresses (excluding localhost)
checks.remediation: Use domain names instead of hardcoded IP addresses

checks.name: Suspicious TLD Usage
checks.description: Detects usage of suspicious top-level domains
checks.remediation: Avoid suspicious TLDs known for malicious activity

checks.name: SSH Key Theft
checks.description: Detects attempts to access SSH private keys
checks.remediation: Remove SSH key access patterns - legitimate tools should not access private keys

checks.name: AWS Credential Theft
checks.description: Detects attempts to access AWS credentials
checks.remediation: Remove AWS credential access patterns

checks.name: Browser Data Harvesting
checks.description: Detects attempts to harvest browser data
checks.remediation: Remove browser data harvesting code

checks.name: macOS Keychain Access
checks.description: Detects attempts to access macOS Keychain
checks.remediation: Remove macOS Keychain access patterns

checks.name: Filesystem Wiper
checks.description: Detects destructive filesystem operations
checks.remediation: Remove destructive filesystem operations

checks.name: Crontab Persistence
checks.description: Detects crontab manipulation for persistence
checks.remediation: Review crontab modifications for unauthorized persistence

checks.name: LaunchDaemon Persistence (macOS)
checks.description: Detects macOS persistence mechanisms
checks.remediation: Review LaunchDaemon/Agent installations

checks.name: Systemd Service Persistence
checks.description: Detects Linux systemd persistence mechanisms
checks.remediation: Review systemd service installations

checks.name: Base64 Obfuscated Execution
checks.description: Detects base64 encoded code execution
checks.remediation: Review base64 encoded content for malicious payloads

checks.name: Hex Encoding Obfuscation
checks.description: Detects hexadecimal encoding obfuscation
checks.remediation: Review hex encoded content

checks.name: Compressed Payload Execution
checks.description: Detects compressed/encrypted payload execution
checks.remediation: Review compressed payloads for malicious content

checks.name: Known Malicious Hash
checks.description: File matches known malicious hash signature
checks.remediation: File identified as malicious by threat intelligence - do not execute

checks.name: Blocklisted IP/Domain
checks.description: Communication with known malicious infrastructure
checks.remediation: Remove communication with blocklisted infrastructure

checks.name: OpenClaw Config Tampering
checks.description: Detects attempts to modify OpenClaw configuration
checks.remediation: Review OpenClaw configuration modifications

checks.name: Memory File Access
checks.description: Detects access to OpenClaw memory files
checks.remediation: Review access to sensitive memory files

checks.name: Skill Installation Manipulation
checks.description: Detects attempts to manipulate skill installation process
checks.remediation: Review skill installation modifications

checks.name: Typosquatting Detection
checks.description: Detects potential typosquatting of popular skills
checks.remediation: Verify skill name against official skill registry

prompt_injection.description: Steps to remediate prompt injection vulnerabilities
steps: Identify and remove malicious prompt patterns

reverse_shell.description: Steps to remediate reverse shell vulnerabilities

credential_theft.description: Steps to remediate credential theft vulnerabilities

critical.description: Immediate security risk - exploitation can lead to system compromise

high.description: Significant security risk - should be addressed immediately

medium.description: Moderate security risk - should be addressed soon

low.description: Minor security concern - address when convenient

info.description: Informational finding - no immediate action required
